title: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker and the waymaster, the actual leader of the Jeskai, who watches a troupe dramatize the rebellion in which she took part, then corrects their story.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A winged woman with glowing eyes who has arrived on Tarkir seeking Narset; Narset names her and fears something terrible has happened.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The dragonlord of the Jeskai, Narset's former teacher whom she adored, and whose face the performers wear in a mask.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: The snake-headed dragonlord who ruled the Sultai, endlessly paranoid.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The antlered dragonlord who devoured the Temur whisperers and reduced the clan to a hunting pack.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: The spined dragonlord of the Mardu, who divided them and made a truce with the clan.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dragonlord of the Abzan, who forced them to repudiate their honored dead.

entities.name: Eshki Dragonclaw
entities.description: Leader of the Temur rebellion, portrayed by a mask in the troupe's show.

entities.name: Alniul, the Twice Whisperer
entities.description: A Temur whisperer who foretold the rebellion's victory and helped Narset find the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Zurgo Stormrender
entities.description: Leader of the Mardu rebellion, portrayed in the troupe's show.

entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: Leader of the Abzan rebellion, portrayed in the troupe's show.

entities.name: Kotis
entities.description: Leader of the Sultai rebellion, who died and returned; portrayed in the troupe's show.

entities.name: Shiko
entities.description: The Jeskai spirit dragon Narset called from the ritual and rode into battle, shaped by her beliefs; she respects but does not love it.

entities.name: Betor
entities.description: The Abzan spirit dragon, brilliant as the desert sun, made of the lost spirits of the Abzan.

entities.name: Teval
entities.description: The Sultai spirit dragon, fair and ruthlessly impartial.

entities.name: Neriv
entities.description: The Mardu spirit dragon, who brings the clan together and espouses the strength of the collective.

entities.name: Ureni
entities.description: The zealous Temur spirit dragon who protects the clan.

entities.name: Traveling performers
entities.description: A pair of illusionist performers in masks, probably twins, who stage a show about the rebellion at the tavern; they are unnamed.

entities.name: Dirgur Lake Monastery
entities.description: A monastery whose fishing village holds the tavern where Narset watches the show.

entities.name: The Salt Road
entities.description: A road on Tarkir for which the tavern is often the first or last stop.

entities.name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: The place where Narset and the rebellion leaders cast the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: An ancient spell, perhaps as old as the Multiverse, that invoked the essence of Tarkir and summoned a dragonstorm from which the spirit dragons emerged.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms that remain after the dragonlords' defeat, growing strong enough to reshape the land and spawn wild dragons.

entities.name: Spirit dragons
entities.description: Dragons that emerged from the Stormnexus dragonstorm, embodying each clan's greatest hopes and bound to the rebellion leaders.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir, now led in practice by Narset.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir that rebelled against the dragonlords.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir that had a truce with Kolaghan before the rebellion.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir devoted to its ancestors.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir, ruled by Silumgar, whose members can return from death.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where five clans rebelled against the dragonlords.

events.summary: Narset watches a masked traveling troupe prepare in a crowded tavern near Dirgur Lake Monastery.
events.quote: She sat just close enough to be able to hear the two giggling to one another in a halfway familiar dialect.

events.summary: The troupe opens its show, and a performer is suddenly wearing a mask of Ojutai that Narset sees in her nightmares.
The performer appears in a death-mask version of Narset's face as the hero of the story, and a Temur patron objects that Narset had to be persuaded.
events.quote: wore Narset's face, or at least the version someone would engrave onto a death mask

events.summary: Patrons from different clans quarrel over which rebellion leader was the real hero, while illusions of the dragonlords roar out of the smoke.
events.quote: snake-headed Silumgar, Atarka with her crown of antlers, spined Kolaghan, Dromoka shining like the sun, and of course, feathered Ojutai

events.summary: Narset remembers her years as Ojutai's favored student and admits that in saving Tarkir she lost her dragon.
events.quote: In saving Tarkir, Narset lost her dragon.

events.summary: A Sultai noble tells the Mardu engineer how a hungry Mardu boy killed her for two days of rice.
events.quote: He killed me for two days' worth of rice.

events.summary: The performers change masks to portray the five rebellion leaders, each clan's hero.
events.quote: they were masked again, this time in the images of Eshki Dragonclaw and Alniul, the Twice Whisperer

events.summary: The crowd roars and Narset has a panic response, calming herself by counting.
events.quote: After a few moments, the panic eased its grip, enough that Narset could breathe again.

events.summary: The performers conjure a diorama of the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon and narrate the discovery of the Stormnexus Ritual; Narset recalls the desperate gamble.
events.quote: It'd been a gamble; they had no idea what the ritual would do.

events.summary: Illusory spirit dragons fly overhead as Narset reflects on each clan's dragon and on her lack of love for Shiko.
events.quote: But she didn't love Shiko, no, not with those wings of hers, like so many scrolls unfurling through the air

events.summary: Patrons erupt into arguments over how the rebellion leaders chose their dragons, derailing the show.
events.quote: Full-throated arguments shook loose across the tavern, as the patrons gleefully took to defending their own apocrypha.

events.summary: Narset stops the quarrel and tells how the dragons were unformed and she first leapt onto one, binding herself to Shiko; they rode into battle and drove the dragonlords into the storm.
events.quote: I was the first to leap onto one.

events.summary: Narset warns the crowd that the dragonstorms have grown worse, reshaping the land and spawning wild dragons.
events.quote: They've become strong enough to reshape the very land.

events.summary: A breathless man bursts in seeking the waymaster and announces that a winged woman with glowing eyes has arrived.
events.quote: She has wings , my khan. And glowing eyes.

events.summary: Narset names the visitor as Elspeth and fears something terrible has happened.

relations.quote: Narset was the waymaster—the actual leader of the Jeskai now, really

relations.note: the Great Teacher and his perfect student
relations.quote: The Great Teacher and his perfect student.

relations.note: bound to the spirit dragon she called from the ritual
relations.quote: the spirit dragon whom she'd called from the ritual, whom she'd ridden into battle against the dragonlords

relations.note: she fought the dragonlords despite loving him

relations.quote: Along with wise Alniul had discovered an ancient spell

relations.note: the Mardu had a truce with Kolaghan and her brood
relations.quote: We had a truce with Kolaghan and her brood.
after centuries of living under Silumgar's rule

relations.quote: the lost spirits of the Abzan brought together into a singular form.
